mapper.select: SELECT t.revision,l.task_kind,l.lifecycle FROM ja_conversation_thread t LEFT JOIN ja_conversation_lineage l ON l.child_thread_id=t.thread_id WHERE t.thread_id=#{threadId} AND t.deleted_at_ms IS NULL

SELECT plan_id,owner_thread_id,objective,create_operation_key,status,revision,active_plan_revision_id,active_run_id,created_at_ms,updated_at_ms FROM ja_plan WHERE owner_thread_id=#{ownerThreadId} AND create_operation_key=#{createOperationKey}
SELECT revision FROM ja_conversation_thread WHERE thread_id=#{threadId} AND deleted_at_ms IS NULL

SELECT plan_id,owner_thread_id,objective,create_operation_key,status,revision,active_plan_revision_id,active_run_id,created_at_ms,updated_at_ms FROM ja_plan WHERE owner_thread_id=#{ownerThreadId} ORDER BY updated_at_ms DESC,plan_id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT event_sequence,event_id,plan_id,plan_revision,activity,created_at_ms FROM ja_plan_event WHERE plan_id=#{planId} ORDER BY event_sequence DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT plan_draft_id,plan_id,draft_revision,definition_json,based_on_plan_revision_id,updated_at_ms FROM ja_plan_draft WHERE plan_id=#{planId}
SELECT plan_revision_id FROM ja_plan_approval WHERE plan_id=#{planId} AND plan_revision_id=#{planRevisionId} AND decision='APPROVED' ORDER BY created_at_ms DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT activity FROM ja_plan_event WHERE plan_id=#{planId} AND operation_key=#{operationKey}
SELECT ordinal,state FROM ja_plan_turn_claim WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND turn_id=#{turnId}
SELECT status,plan_id,plan_revision_id,is_pause_requested,used_model_rounds,used_tool_calls,used_active_millis FROM ja_plan_execution WHERE run_id=#{runId}
SELECT 1 FROM ja_plan_turn_claim WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND state='CLAIMED' LIMIT 1
SELECT 1 FROM ja_plan_turn_claim c JOIN ja_conversation_turn t ON t.turn_id=c.turn_id WHERE c.run_id=#{runId} AND c.state='CLAIMED' AND t.state IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED','CANCELLED') LIMIT 1
SELECT 1 FROM ja_plan_turn_claim WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND turn_id=#{turnId}
SELECT state FROM ja_conversation_turn WHERE turn_id=#{turnId}

SELECT evidence_id,plan_id,run_id,plan_revision_id,criterion_id,step_id,source_type,source_id,summary,digest,observed_at_ms,created_at_ms FROM ja_plan_acceptance_evidence WHERE evidence_id=#{evidenceId}
SELECT provider_id,model_id FROM ja_conversation_thread WHERE thread_id=#{threadId}
SELECT plan_id,plan_revision_id FROM ja_plan_execution WHERE run_id=#{runId}

SELECT plan_id,owner_thread_id,objective,create_operation_key,status,revision,active_plan_revision_id,active_run_id,created_at_ms,updated_at_ms FROM ja_plan WHERE owner_thread_id=#{ownerThreadId} AND status='EXECUTING' ORDER BY updated_at_ms DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT origin,context_json FROM ja_turn_internal_context WHERE turn_id=#{turnId}

SELECT c.turn_id FROM ja_turn_internal_context c JOIN ja_conversation_turn t ON t.turn_id=c.turn_id WHERE c.origin='PLAN_EXECUTION' AND json_extract(c.context_json,'$.planId')=#{planId} AND json_extract(c.context_json,'$.runId')=#{runId} AND (t.state IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','WAITING_APPROVAL','WAITING_INPUT','SUSPENDED') OR (t.state IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED','CANCELLED') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ja_plan_turn_claim claim WHERE claim.run_id=#{runId} AND claim.turn_id=c.turn_id AND claim.state='CLAIMED'))) ORDER BY t.updated_at_ms DESC,t.turn_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT 1 FROM ja_plan_execution e JOIN ja_plan_turn_claim c ON c.run_id=e.run_id JOIN ja_conversation_turn t ON t.turn_id=c.turn_id LEFT JOIN ja_turn_internal_context x ON x.turn_id=t.turn_id WHERE e.plan_id=#{planId} AND e.run_id=#{runId} AND c.state='CLAIMED' AND (x.turn_id IS NULL OR x.origin<>'PLAN_EXECUTION' OR json_extract(x.context_json,'$.planId') IS NOT e.plan_id OR json_extract(x.context_json,'$.runId') IS NOT e.run_id OR json_extract(x.context_json,'$.planRevisionId') IS NOT e.plan_revision_id OR json_extract(x.context_json,'$.planHash') IS NOT e.plan_hash) LIMIT 1

SELECT plan_id,owner_thread_id,objective,create_operation_key,status,revision,active_plan_revision_id,active_run_id,created_at_ms,updated_at_ms FROM ja_plan WHERE owner_thread_id=#{ownerThreadId} AND status IN ('DRAFT','AWAITING_APPROVAL','APPROVED','EXECUTING','VERIFYING','PAUSED')

SELECT x.step_id FROM ja_plan_step_execution x JOIN ja_plan_step s ON s.plan_revision_id=x.plan_revision_id AND s.step_id=x.step_id WHERE x.run_id=#{runId} AND x.status IN ('RUNNING','READY') ORDER BY CASE x.status WHEN 'RUNNING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,s.ordinal LIMIT 1
SELECT plan_revision_id,plan_id,revision_number,definition_json,plan_hash,created_by,created_at_ms FROM ja_plan_revision WHERE plan_id=#{planId} ORDER BY revision_number DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT approval_id,plan_id,plan_revision_id,plan_hash,decision,created_at_ms FROM ja_plan_approval WHERE plan_id=#{planId} AND plan_revision_id=#{planRevisionId} AND decision='APPROVED' ORDER BY created_at_ms DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT p.owner_thread_id FROM ja_plan p JOIN ja_conversation_thread t ON t.thread_id=p.owner_thread_id WHERE p.plan_id=#{planId}
SELECT 1 FROM ja_plan_execution r JOIN ja_plan p ON p.plan_id=r.plan_id WHERE p.owner_thread_id=#{ownerThreadId} AND r.status IN ('PREPARED','RUNNING','VERIFYING','PAUSED') LIMIT 1
SELECT 1 FROM ja_plan_execution WHERE plan_id=#{planId} AND status IN ('PREPARED','RUNNING','VERIFYING','PAUSED') LIMIT 1

WITH RECURSIVE ancestors(thread_id) AS (SELECT #{threadId} UNION ALL SELECT l.parent_thread_id FROM ja_conversation_lineage l JOIN ancestors a ON l.child_thread_id=a.thread_id) SELECT c.thread_id FROM ja_conversation_thread c JOIN ancestors a ON a.thread_id=c.thread_id WHERE c.temporary_lifecycle_state='CLOSING' ORDER BY c.thread_id LIMIT 1
SELECT 1 FROM ja_plan_approval WHERE plan_id=#{planId} AND plan_revision_id=#{planRevisionId} AND plan_hash=#{planHash} AND decision='APPROVED'
SELECT plan_revision_id,plan_id,revision_number,definition_json,plan_hash,created_by,created_at_ms FROM ja_plan_revision WHERE plan_id=#{planId} AND plan_revision_id=#{planRevisionId}
SELECT plan_id,owner_thread_id,objective,create_operation_key,status,revision,active_plan_revision_id,active_run_id,created_at_ms,updated_at_ms FROM ja_plan WHERE plan_id=#{planId}
SELECT 1 FROM ja_plan_event WHERE plan_id=#{planId} AND operation_key=#{operationKey}

SELECT s.step_id,s.title,s.is_required,COALESCE(x.status,'PENDING') AS status FROM ja_plan_step s LEFT JOIN ja_plan_step_execution x ON x.run_id=#{runId} AND x.step_id=s.step_id WHERE s.plan_revision_id=#{planRevisionId} ORDER BY s.ordinal
SELECT event_sequence,event_id,plan_id,plan_revision,activity,created_at_ms FROM ja_plan_event WHERE plan_id=#{planId} AND event_sequence>#{eventSequence} ORDER BY event_sequence LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT plan_revision_id,plan_id,revision_number,definition_json,plan_hash,created_by,created_at_ms FROM ja_plan_revision WHERE plan_id=#{planId} AND revision_number>#{revisionNumber} ORDER BY revision_number LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT evidence_id,plan_id,run_id,plan_revision_id,criterion_id,step_id,source_type,source_id,summary,digest,observed_at_ms,created_at_ms FROM ja_plan_acceptance_evidence WHERE plan_id=#{planId} AND run_id=#{runId} AND plan_revision_id=#{planRevisionId} ORDER BY created_at_ms,evidence_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT x.run_id,x.plan_revision_id,x.step_id,x.status,x.attempt_count,x.failure_signature,x.started_at_ms,x.completed_at_ms,x.updated_at_ms FROM ja_plan_step_execution x JOIN ja_plan_step s ON s.plan_revision_id=x.plan_revision_id AND s.step_id=x.step_id WHERE x.run_id=#{runId} ORDER BY s.ordinal

SELECT p.plan_id,p.revision,p.active_run_id,p.active_plan_revision_id,CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ja_plan_tool_attempt a WHERE a.run_id=r.run_id AND (a.state IN ('PREPARED','UNKNOWN') OR (a.state='STARTED' AND a.side_effect=1))) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ja_plan_evaluation_attempt e WHERE e.run_id=r.run_id AND e.outcome IN ('RUNNING','UNKNOWN')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS unsafe FROM ja_plan p JOIN ja_plan_execution r ON r.run_id=p.active_run_id WHERE r.plan_id=p.plan_id AND r.process_generation<>#{processGeneration} AND p.status IN ('EXECUTING','VERIFYING') ORDER BY p.updated_at_ms,p.plan_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ja_plan_draft(plan_draft_id,plan_id,draft_revision,definition_json,based_on_plan_revision_id,updated_at_ms) VALUES(#{planDraftId},#{planId},1,#{definitionJson},#{basedOnPlanRevisionId},#{updatedAt,typeHandler=io.github.kongweiguang.ja.infrastructure.persistence.mapper.EpochMillisStringTypeHandler,jdbcType=BIGINT}) ON CONFLICT(plan_id) DO UPDATE SET draft_revision=ja_plan_draft.draft_revision+1,definition_json=excluded.definition_json,based_on_plan_revision_id=excluded.based_on_plan_revision_id,updated_at_ms=excluded.updated_at_ms
mapper.update: UPDATE ja_plan_execution SET updated_at_ms=#{updatedAt,typeHandler=io.github.kongweiguang.ja.infrastructure.persistence.mapper.EpochMillisStringTypeHandler,jdbcType=BIGINT} WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND status='RUNNING' AND is_pause_requested=0

UPDATE ja_plan_execution SET used_model_rounds=#{usedModelRounds},used_tool_calls=#{usedToolCalls},used_active_millis=#{usedActiveMillis},updated_at_ms=#{updatedAt,typeHandler=io.github.kongweiguang.ja.infrastructure.persistence.mapper.EpochMillisStringTypeHandler,jdbcType=BIGINT} WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND status IN ('RUNNING','PAUSED')
UPDATE ja_plan_turn_claim SET state='SETTLED' WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND turn_id=#{turnId} AND state='CLAIMED'

UPDATE ja_plan_execution SET used_active_millis=#{usedActiveMillis},updated_at_ms=#{updatedAt,typeHandler=io.github.kongweiguang.ja.infrastructure.persistence.mapper.EpochMillisStringTypeHandler,jdbcType=BIGINT} WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND status IN ('RUNNING','PAUSED')

UPDATE ja_plan_execution SET is_pause_requested=1,updated_at_ms=#{updatedAt,typeHandler=io.github.kongweiguang.ja.infrastructure.persistence.mapper.EpochMillisStringTypeHandler,jdbcType=BIGINT} WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND plan_id=#{planId} AND status IN ('RUNNING','VERIFYING','PAUSED')
UPDATE ja_plan_turn_claim SET state='ABANDONED' WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND state='CLAIMED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ja_conversation_turn t WHERE t.turn_id=ja_plan_turn_claim.turn_id)

UPDATE ja_plan_execution SET status=#{status},completed_at_ms=CASE WHEN #{completedStatus} IN ('COMPLETED','STOPPED') THEN #{completedAt,typeHandler=io.github.kongweiguang.ja.infrastructure.persistence.mapper.EpochMillisStringTypeHandler,jdbcType=BIGINT} ELSE NULL END,updated_at_ms=#{updatedAt,typeHandler=io.github.kongweiguang.ja.infrastructure.persistence.mapper.EpochMillisStringTypeHandler,jdbcType=BIGINT} WHERE run_id=#{runId}

UPDATE ja_plan_step_execution SET status=#{status},attempt_count=attempt_count+CASE WHEN #{runningStatus}='RUNNING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,failure_signature=#{failureSignature},started_at_ms=CASE WHEN #{startedStatus}='RUNNING' THEN #{startedAt,typeHandler=io.github.kongweiguang.ja.infrastructure.persistence.mapper.EpochMillisStringTypeHandler,jdbcType=BIGINT} ELSE started_at_ms END,completed_at_ms=#{completedAt,typeHandler=io.github.kongweiguang.ja.infrastructure.persistence.mapper.EpochMillisStringTypeHandler,jdbcType=BIGINT},updated_at_ms=#{updatedAt,typeHandler=io.github.kongweiguang.ja.infrastructure.persistence.mapper.EpochMillisStringTypeHandler,jdbcType=BIGINT} WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND step_id=#{stepId} AND status=#{expectedStatus}

UPDATE ja_plan_step_execution SET status='READY',updated_at_ms=#{updatedAt,typeHandler=io.github.kongweiguang.ja.infrastructure.persistence.mapper.EpochMillisStringTypeHandler,jdbcType=BIGINT} WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND status='PENDING' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM json_each((SELECT dependency_ids_json FROM ja_plan_step s WHERE s.plan_revision_id=ja_plan_step_execution.plan_revision_id AND s.step_id=ja_plan_step_execution.step_id)) d JOIN ja_plan_step_execution dep ON dep.run_id=ja_plan_step_execution.run_id AND dep.step_id=d.value WHERE dep.status<>'SUCCEEDED')

UPDATE ja_plan SET status=#{status},revision=revision+1,active_plan_revision_id=#{activePlanRevisionId},active_run_id=#{activeRunId},updated_at_ms=#{updatedAt,typeHandler=io.github.kongweiguang.ja.infrastructure.persistence.mapper.EpochMillisStringTypeHandler,jdbcType=BIGINT} WHERE plan_id=#{planId} AND revision=#{revision}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ja_plan WHERE owner_thread_id=#{ownerThreadId} AND status NOT IN ('COMPLETED','STOPPED')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ja_conversation_turn t JOIN ja_turn_internal_context x ON x.turn_id=t.turn_id WHERE json_extract(x.context_json,'$.runId')=#{runId} AND t.state IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING','WAITING_APPROVAL','WAITING_INPUT','SUSPENDED')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ja_interaction_request i WHERE i.thread_id=#{threadId} AND i.status='PENDING' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM json_each(i.questions_json) q WHERE json_extract(q.value,'$.required')=1)
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(revision_number),0)+1 FROM ja_plan_revision WHERE plan_id=#{planId}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(ordinal),0)+1 FROM ja_plan_turn_claim WHERE run_id=#{runId}
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT model_round) FROM ja_turn_usage WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND purpose='ASSISTANT'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ja_tool_call WHERE turn_id=#{turnId}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(event_sequence),0) FROM ja_plan_event WHERE plan_id=#{planId}

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ja_plan_step s LEFT JOIN ja_plan_step_execution x ON x.run_id=#{runId} AND x.step_id=s.step_id WHERE s.plan_revision_id=#{planRevisionId} AND s.is_required=1 AND COALESCE(x.status,'')<>'SUCCEEDED')+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ja_plan_acceptance_criterion p WHERE p.plan_revision_id=#{planRevisionId2} AND p.is_required=1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ja_plan_acceptance_evidence e WHERE e.run_id=#{runId2} AND e.plan_revision_id=p.plan_revision_id AND e.criterion_id=p.criterion_id))+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ja_plan_tool_attempt t WHERE t.run_id=#{runId3} AND t.state IN ('PREPARED','STARTED','UNKNOWN'))+(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ja_interaction_request i WHERE i.run_id=#{runId4} AND i.status='PENDING')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ja_plan_step WHERE plan_revision_id=#{planRevisionId} AND is_required=1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ja_plan_step_execution x JOIN ja_plan_step s ON s.plan_revision_id=x.plan_revision_id AND s.step_id=x.step_id WHERE x.run_id=#{runId} AND s.is_required=1 AND x.status='SUCCEEDED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ja_plan_acceptance_criterion WHERE plan_revision_id=#{planRevisionId} AND criterion_id=#{criterionId}

SELECT evidence_id,plan_id,run_id,plan_revision_id,criterion_id,step_id,source_type,source_id,summary,digest,observed_at_ms,created_at_ms FROM ja_plan_acceptance_evidence WHERE plan_id=#{planId} AND run_id=#{runId} AND plan_revision_id=#{planRevisionId} AND (created_at_ms>#{createdAt,typeHandler=io.github.kongweiguang.ja.infrastructure.persistence.mapper.EpochMillisStringTypeHandler,jdbcType=BIGINT} OR (created_at_ms=#{createdAt2} AND evidence_id>#{evidenceId})) ORDER BY created_at_ms,evidence_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT tool_attempt_id,plan_id,run_id,plan_revision_id,step_id,attempt,turn_id,call_id,process_generation,side_effect,state,request_digest,result_digest,prepared_at_ms,started_at_ms,completed_at_ms FROM ja_plan_tool_attempt WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND call_id=#{callId} AND state='SUCCEEDED'
SELECT 1 FROM ja_plan_tool_attempt WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND state IN ('PREPARED','STARTED','UNKNOWN') LIMIT 1

SELECT tool_attempt_id,plan_id,run_id,plan_revision_id,step_id,attempt,turn_id,call_id,process_generation,side_effect,state,request_digest,result_digest,prepared_at_ms,started_at_ms,completed_at_ms FROM ja_plan_tool_attempt WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND state IN ('PREPARED','STARTED','UNKNOWN') ORDER BY prepared_at_ms,tool_attempt_id

SELECT json_object('appTurnState',t.state,'coreState',e.state,'mutationVersion',e.mutation_version,'cursorSchemaVersion',e.cursor_schema_version,'cursorJson',e.cursor_json,'lastRecordSequence',e.last_record_sequence,'userId',e.user_id,'runPlanId',r.plan_id,'runRevisionId',r.plan_revision_id,'runHash',r.plan_hash) FROM ja_conversation_turn t JOIN ja_conversation_thread owner ON owner.thread_id=t.thread_id JOIN agent_execution e ON e.tenant_id='ja.local' AND e.thread_id=t.thread_id AND e.turn_id=t.turn_id AND e.user_id=owner.owner_user_id JOIN ja_plan_turn_claim claim ON claim.turn_id=t.turn_id AND claim.run_id=#{runId} AND claim.state='CLAIMED' JOIN ja_plan_execution r ON r.run_id=claim.run_id WHERE t.thread_id=#{threadId} AND t.turn_id=#{turnId}

SELECT json_object('recordType',record_type,'recordId',record_id,'schemaVersion',payload_schema_version,'recordSequence',record_sequence,'payloadJson',payload_json) FROM agent_record WHERE tenant_id='ja.local' AND thread_id=#{threadId} AND turn_id=#{turnId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND record_sequence<=#{lastRecordSequence} AND ((record_type='agent.assistant' AND json_extract(payload_json,'$.messageId')=#{assistantMessageId}) OR (record_type IN ('agent.tool.prepared','agent.tool.started','agent.tool.result') AND json_extract(payload_json,'$.callId')=#{callId})) ORDER BY record_sequence

SELECT json_object('eventType',event_type,'schemaVersion',payload_schema_version,'eventSequence',event_sequence,'payloadJson',payload_json) FROM agent_event WHERE tenant_id='ja.local' AND thread_id=#{threadId} AND turn_id=#{turnId} AND user_id=#{userId} AND mutation_version<=#{mutationVersion} AND last_record_sequence<=#{lastRecordSequence} AND ((event_type='agent.model.completed' AND json_extract(payload_json,'$.messageRecordId')=#{assistantRecordId}) OR (event_type IN ('agent.tool.started','agent.tool.completed') AND json_extract(payload_json,'$.callId')=#{callId})) ORDER BY event_sequence

SELECT tool_attempt_id,plan_id,run_id,plan_revision_id,step_id,attempt,turn_id,call_id,process_generation,side_effect,state,request_digest,result_digest,prepared_at_ms,started_at_ms,completed_at_ms FROM ja_plan_tool_attempt WHERE tool_attempt_id=#{toolAttemptId}

SELECT tool_attempt_id,plan_id,run_id,plan_revision_id,step_id,attempt,turn_id,call_id,process_generation,side_effect,state,request_digest,result_digest,prepared_at_ms,started_at_ms,completed_at_ms FROM ja_plan_tool_attempt WHERE turn_id=#{turnId} AND call_id=#{callId} ORDER BY attempt,tool_attempt_id

SELECT tool_attempt_id,plan_id,run_id,plan_revision_id,step_id,attempt,turn_id,call_id,process_generation,side_effect,state,request_digest,result_digest,prepared_at_ms,started_at_ms,completed_at_ms FROM ja_plan_tool_attempt WHERE process_generation<>#{processGeneration} AND state='STARTED' ORDER BY prepared_at_ms,tool_attempt_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE ja_plan_tool_attempt SET state='STARTED',started_at_ms=#{startedAt,typeHandler=io.github.kongweiguang.ja.infrastructure.persistence.mapper.EpochMillisStringTypeHandler,jdbcType=BIGINT} WHERE tool_attempt_id=#{toolAttemptId} AND state='PREPARED'

UPDATE ja_plan_tool_attempt SET state=#{state},result_digest=#{resultDigest},completed_at_ms=#{completedAt,typeHandler=io.github.kongweiguang.ja.infrastructure.persistence.mapper.EpochMillisStringTypeHandler,jdbcType=BIGINT} WHERE tool_attempt_id=#{toolAttemptId} AND state='STARTED'

UPDATE ja_plan_tool_attempt SET state=#{state},result_digest=#{resultDigest},completed_at_ms=#{completedAt,typeHandler=io.github.kongweiguang.ja.infrastructure.persistence.mapper.EpochMillisStringTypeHandler,jdbcType=BIGINT} WHERE tool_attempt_id=#{toolAttemptId} AND state='PREPARED' AND started_at_ms IS NULL AND completed_at_ms IS NULL AND result_digest IS NULL
